title: Vision-Language Models are Fragile Multilingual Associators
abstract: arXiv:2608.12333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models must associate visual entities with textual attributes. Whether these associations or concept bindings remain stable when the language of the input changes is unexplored. We introduce M$^2$BIND, a benchmark varying the language of the context and query across multiple languages. We evaluate binding both extrinsically through task performance metrics and intrinsically through causal interventions. We find that binding is not language-invariant: cross-family and cross-script settings trigger significant binding collapse, with the model's internal binding computation shifting to later layers and losing causal strength. Closely related languages preserve associations comparatively better. In a broader sense, our findings indicate how VLMs deployed globally in multilingual settings cannot be assumed to maintain the same association quality observed in monolingual evaluation.

translated_title: 视觉-语言模型是脆弱的 multilingual 关联器
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型必须将视觉实体与文本属性相关联。当输入语言变化时，这些关联或概念绑定是否保持稳定尚未被探索。我们引入了 M²BIND 基准，该基准在多种语言中变化上下文和查询的语言。我们通过任务性能指标进行外在评估，并通过因果干预进行内在评估。我们发现绑定并非语言不变的：跨语言家族和跨文字系统设置会触发显著的绑定崩溃，模型的内部绑定计算会转移到更深层并失去因果强度。密切相关语言能相对较好地保持关联。从更广泛意义上讲，我们的发现表明，在全球多语言环境中部署的 VLM 不能假设能保持单语评估中观察到的相同关联质量。
tldr: 本论文揭示视觉-语言模型在多语言输入下关联能力脆弱，跨语言家族和文字系统时绑定会崩溃，并引入 M²BIND 基准来评估这一现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that vision-language models are fragile in multilingual association, with binding collapsing across language families and scripts, and introduces the M²BIND benchmark to evaluate this phenomenon.
